summary_1line: Rama, distressed by public criticism of Sita despite her proven innocence, tells Lakshmana he must take her away to a forest hermitage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama sits with a grief-stricken face before his brothers, declaring that public censure forces him to send the innocent Sita away.
Rama recalls Sita stepping into the blazing sacrificial fire while the gods and sages watch as witnesses to her purity.
